Sanitized Budget and Scope Summary for C2Pro fixture validation.

The works include selective demolition, structural steel reinforcement, envelope
repairs, internal partitions, mechanical coordination, electrical containment,
and quality inspections for a commercial refurbishment project. The approved
budget is organized by trade package and includes allowances for temporary
works, waste removal, site logistics, commissioning support, and closeout
documentation.

The Site Supervisor must confirm that no added ceiling works are started until
the revised access method statement is approved. The scope excludes tenant
furniture, loose equipment, and post-handover maintenance. Any instruction that
adds these excluded items must be treated as a formal variation and must include
budget impact, programme impact, and supporting evidence.
